title: Trump Today: Trump Today: President talks trade with Apple’s Tim Cook
text:
Published: Apr 25, 2018 4:10 p.m. ET Share
Trump replies to Kanye West: ‘Very cool!’
By Robert Schroeder Fiscal policy reporter This column provides a daily update on key presidential actions as well as comments, whether spoken aloud or on Twitter, by President Trump. Like the stock market, the deadline for Trump Today action is 4 p.m. Eastern Time, even as we acknowledge that substantive news can and does occur after hours.
President Donald Trump met with Apple CEO Tim Cook on Wednesday, congratulated the winner of a special House race in Arizona, and said he would watch President Emmanuel Macron’s address to Congress.
TRADE TALK WITH APPLE’S COOK
Trump tweeted that he would talk about “many things” with the Apple AAPL, +0.44% chief executive, “including how the U.S. has been treated unfairly for many years, by many countries, on trade.” Cook attended the first state dinner of the Trump presidency on Tuesday night, and has met Trump previously. The Apple CEO said last month in Beijing he hoped the U.S. and China could resolve their trade differences . Looking forward to my meeting with Tim Cook of Apple. We will be talking about many things, including how the U.S. has been treated unfairly for many years, by many countries, on trade.
Also see: White House says Trump would be ‘open to’ meeting Bezos .
‘VERY COOL!’ REPLY TO WEST
After rapper Kanye West called Trump “my brother” on Twitter, Trump tweeted simply, “Thank you Kanye, very cool!” The Grammy Award-winner made waves across the entertainment industry with his pro-Trump tweets . “You don’t have to agree with trump but the mob can’t make me not love him,” West said. “We are both dragon energy.” Thank you Kanye, very cool! https://t.co/vRIC87M21X — Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) April 25, 2018
CONGRATULATIONS TO WINNING REPUBLICAN
Trump gave a shout-out to Debbie Lesko on Twitter after the Republican defeated Democrat Hiral Tipirneni in a special election Tuesday. Lesko fills the seat vacated by Rep. Trent Franks, who resigned after reportedly offering to pay a female staffer to carry his child as a surrogate.
“Debbie will do a Great Job!” Trump tweeted. “Press is so silent.” Lesko won by only about five points in a district that Trump carried by more than 20 — a sign of Democratic enthusiasm as this year’s midterm elections approach. Congratulations to Republican Debbie Lesko on her big win in the Special Election for Arizona House seat. Debbie will do a Great Job! Press is so silent.
Key Words: Harry Reid warns Democrats over Trump impeachment talk: ‘Stop it.’
‘GREAT’ SPEECH BY MACRON
Trump said he was looking forward to watching Macron’s speech to a joint meeting of Congress. “He will be GREAT!” Trump tweeted. The French president issued a plea in his address for the U.S. to maintain its role as a global defender of democracy — and also challenged tenets of Trump’s “America First” agenda , The Wall Street Journal wrote. Busy day planned. Looking forward to watching President Macron of France address a Joint Session of Congress today. This is a great honor and seldom allowed to be done...he will be GREAT! — Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) April 25, 2018 More from MarketWatch
